source_locator: R2281: first day of war, the Slovaks and Germans took the major part of Podhale, including Zakopane and Nowy Targ
notes: Event date: sources covering 1939-09-01, cited below. Korkuć (R2281) dates the Jánošík division crossing the Polish border at 5 a.m. on 1 September and, with German troops, taking Zakopane and Nowy Targ on the first day. The pin is Zakopane, the town Korkuć and Wikipedia/Zaloga name for this division (Wikipedia also names Javorina and an advance toward Nowy Targ). Nowy Targ is already a 1 September pin for German Fourteenth Army (PL4974) and is not reused here. The 1 September order-of-battle sector Spišská Nová Ves–Prešov (Wikipedia, R2283, tertiary) is the assembly sector, not the pin. Confidence is capped at 0.5. Event definition: A dated headquarters, capture or sector location for Field Army Bernolák or one of its divisions in September 1939. Event support: Korkuć (R2281), valka.cz citing Baka and Kliment (R2282), and/or English Wikipedia (R2283, tertiary). Location: place PL5050, precision 3 km.
